The Eagles are going to win the NFC East this season — I'm saying it now, they finish at least 11 and 6. Jalen Hurts is the MVP frontrunner and I fully expect him to top 4,500 passing yards with 35 total touchdowns by the end of the regular season. Their offensive line is the best in football and Saquon Barkley will rush for over 1,400 yards.

The Chiefs dynasty is finished. Patrick Mahomes will miss the playoffs for the first time in his career as the offensive line collapses and they finish below 500 in the AFC West. Book it. Travis Kelce retires after this season regardless of how they perform, and the Chiefs will not win another Super Bowl before 2028.
